terms.definition: The plant tissue of long hollow tubes that carry water and minerals upward from the roots.
terms.function: Delivers water to the leaves and the whole plant.
terms.whereItIs: Running through the roots, stem, and into the leaves.
terms.whyItMatters: It is how the plant gets water from the ground to high-up leaves.

terms.definition: One long hollow pipe that is part of the xylem bundle, joined end to end with others.
terms.function: Provides a continuous water pipe for the plant.
terms.whereItIs: As a bundle of tubes in the stem, roots, and leaves.
terms.whyItMatters: The tubes stack into the plant's long-distance water pipe.

terms.definition: The water and dissolved mineral nutrients the roots absorb, carried up by xylem.
terms.function: Feed the leaves and the rest of the plant.
terms.whereItIs: Moving upward through the xylem tubes from the root.
terms.whyItMatters: They are needed to keep a plant alive and to make food.
